title: Berytech founded by Saint Joseph University
why: First major Lebanese incubator; later coordinates EU Lebanon Innovate and Circular 331 fund.

title: BDL Circular 331 issued
why: Bank equity guarantee scheme for startups and VC funds; created Lebanon's VC industry.

title: First Circular 331 funds launch; ~$400M capacity
why: Mid-2014 first VC funds; capacity later raised toward $650M.

title: Speed@BDD and UK Lebanon Tech Hub era begins
why: Donor and bank backed accelerators cluster in Beirut Digital District. [UK Lebanon Tech Hub launched at BDD, reported 7 May 2015; Speed@BDD launch July 2015 per secondary search summary]

title: Banks had invested $243M under 331 by end-2015
why: Only part of the guaranteed capacity was deployed; most into VC funds.

title: Circular 331 ceiling lifted toward 4% of bank capital
why: Amendments raised available funds above $600M.

title: OMSAR issues first Digital Transformation Strategy
why: Public-sector strategy, not adopted by cabinet until 2022.

title: Law 81/2018 on e-transactions and personal data passed
why: Existing data law, criticised as weak on data protection.

title: Ministry of State for Investment and Technology created (Afiouni)
why: First knowledge-economy ministry; precedent for today's post.

title: Cabinet adopts national cybersecurity strategy
why: Cyber strategy predates MITAI's cyber laws.

title: Government resigns; investment/technology ministry dropped
why: Afiouni says next government dropped mandate and plan.

title: Financial crisis begins; Circular 331 money dries up
why: Banks froze; startup funding collapsed.

title: ESCWA drafts AI strategy advisory for Lebanon
why: Proposed Ministry of Technology and Technology Council; never implemented.

title: BDL authorises e-wallet services
why: Enables Whish and other non-bank payment rails after bank collapse.

title: Anghami starts trading on Nasdaq via SPAC
why: First Arab tech company on Nasdaq; HQ Abu Dhabi.

title: Cabinet approves Digital Transformation Strategy 2020-2030
why: Unanimous approval; implementation slow, OMSAR under-resourced.

title: Toters raises $15M+ Series B
why: IFC, March Holding, B&Y; Lebanese delivery app scales.

title: Lebanese startups raise about $1M across 12 deals
why: Wamda series low point; 95% drop cited by Seedstars.

title: Toters drivers strike over lira pay
why: Documents pricing and pay criticism of the flagship delivery app.

title: EU-funded Lebanon Innovate launches via Berytech
why: Donor-run ecosystem coordination programme, about EUR 3M.

title: Lebanese startups raise $510K across 4 deals
why: Wamda year in review; near-zero domestic startup funding.

title: Shehadi sworn in as Minister of State for Technology and AI
why: Salam government; portfolio combined with Minister of Displaced.

title: Shehadi says $30-50M over two years could transform government
why: Budget ask, not an allocation.

title: LEAP strategy deck first shared
why: 5-year plan with $500M AI investment and 80% digitised services targets.

title: MITAI signs MoU with Sofrecom (Orange) at VivaTech
why: Support for National Digital Infrastructure project; no follow-up figures.

title: Roland Berger MoU reported
why: Consultancy advises MITAI on AI initiatives and governance.

title: Cabinet approves draft law creating full MITAI ministry
why: Still awaiting Parliament a year later.

title: Cabinet grants Starlink licence
why: Two-year licence; commercial launch still pending in Aug 2026.

title: Tech community split on new AI ministry
why: Berytech welcomes; SMEX and SE Factory call it premature or waste.

title: National Digital Transformation and AI Strategy 2025-2030 launched
why: Launched at Lebanon Tech, AI and Innovation Summit under PM Salam.

title: MITAI signs two MoUs with AUB
why: National partnership plus Code for Lebanon with Htech.

title: Oracle MoU to train 50,000 Lebanese
why: Free programme over 5 years; no enrolment numbers published since.

title: Microsoft agreement for startups and AI training announced
why: Announced at Baabda; hope of reopening Beirut office; no metrics.

title: National AI Framework put to public consultation
why: First AI governance document; not a law.

title: World Bank approves $150M Digital Acceleration Project
why: Largest digital financing; implementing agency not confirmed as MITAI.

title: Shehadi promises Gulf digital investment 'in weeks'
why: No named investor or amount found by 30 Sep 2026.

title: 2026 Israel-Hezbollah-Iran war reaches Lebanon
why: War disrupts governance, elections and investment.

title: Cabinet widens Starlink licence under war conditions
why: Adds ministries, embassies, NGOs; security safeguards relaxed.

title: Parliament postpones May elections by two years
why: 76-41 vote; same government continues; Shehadi remains minister.

title: AUB delivers national data-centre benchmark to MITAI
why: Telecom Ministry separately building a National Data Center in Dekwaneh.

title: MITAI-Berytech MoU reported
why: Formal link between ministry and main incubator; AI incubation goals.

title: Hariri Foundation MoU on AI awareness
why: Regional outreach partnership; no numbers.

title: MITAI posts four job openings
why: Deputy Chief of Staff, PM, junior tech, partnerships; office of about 10-20 staff.

title: Lebanon Innovate closes after 46 months
why: Mapped 13 universities, 6 research centres, 5 support orgs, 77 industries.

title: OSN proposes $3.39/share take-private of Anghami
why: Anghami market cap about $30M; HQ Abu Dhabi.

title: Phoenicia University signs MoU with MITAI
why: One of a string of university MoUs; no outcome figures.

title: OMSAR launches Dawlati portal with 12 services
why: State portal for 2,700 services is OMSAR's, not MITAI's; overlap risk.

title: AUT signs MoU; training already started
why: Training municipal staff and students in Jbeil, Koura, Akkar.

title: Parliament refers MITAI law to joint committees
why: SMEX lists four defects; ministry still not legally created.

title: Lebanon signs $150M World Bank digital loan
why: Loan signed by Finance Minister Jaber; funds infrastructure, cybersecurity, hosting.

title: Shehadi briefs Aoun on October Experia Expo
why: Shows Shehadi still in post; expo on tech, AI, startups planned.

title: Starlink still not commercially launched; TRA warns unlicensed sellers
why: Licensed a year earlier; individuals barred; launch date unset.

title: Ookla: Lebanon fixed broadband ranks 141st, mobile 93rd
why: Compute-relevant connectivity still low.

title: Shehadi reports 2,500 residents trained through Zaka
why: Rare published training figure; small against Oracle's 50,000 pledge.

title: Ministry adviser lists national data centre and AI strategy as MITAI goals
why: No capacity, cost or date given for the data centre.

title: Lebanese startups raise $2.8M across 10 deals
why: Wamda 2025 review; compare with $500M AI investment target.
